name: H2
summary:
Unitree H2 is a full-size humanoid platform with a humanlike head and a body approximately 180 cm tall. The manufacturer describes 31 body degrees of freedom, coordinated motion control and high-output joints intended to support dynamic whole-body movement.

The platform offers computing and dexterous-hand options for embodied-intelligence development. Perception and learned models can be combined with its physical interfaces to build manipulation and interaction applications. description.en:
Unitree H2 is a full-size humanoid platform with a humanlike head and a body approximately 180 cm tall. The manufacturer describes 31 body degrees of freedom, coordinated motion control and high-output joints intended to support dynamic whole-body movement.

The platform offers computing and dexterous-hand options for embodied-intelligence development. Perception and learned models can be combined with its physical interfaces to build manipulation and interaction applications. Unitree distinguishes rated payloads from higher peak figures in its specifications, and some equipment is optional. The delivered configuration and software should therefore be checked when comparing demonstrations or assessing a particular use case.

specs.label: Payload per arm
specs.conditions: Approximately 7 kg rated per-arm payload; not the 15 kg peak.

specs.label: Total degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Joint motors; optional hands counted separately.

specs.label: Weight
specs.conditions: Approximately; includes battery, H2 and H2 EDU.
